messages:
maria: Starting blue->green phased shift for eu-west2 (slice B). Window = 23m. Plan: 0% -> 5% -> 15% -> 35% -> pause -> 60% -> 100%. Will pause at 35% to validate cache stability + third-party auth latencies. Notifying oncall @sre-oncall. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-euw-slice-b

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Change window acknowledged. Recording change in runbook: runbook://releases/2026-03-euw-slice-b. Auto-snapshot of current router config taken.

deploy-bot: traffic-shift job queued id=ts-1768511200. Step cadence: 3m. Health probes: p95, 5xx, token-throttle-rate.

jen: Router cookie = `rb_affinity` set for green; fallback to round-robin on cookie miss. Pushed cfg update `router-eu-west2.cfg` (rev r234).

raj: Spinning up synthetic clients for third-party auth path (auth-service eu). Will post results in ~4m.

maria: Go for step1 -> 5%.

deploy-bot: progress: 0% -> 5% (step 1). Health: OK.

sre-oncall: Metrics snapshot: p95=210ms, 5xx=0.0%, throttle=0.0% — green looks healthy.

raj: Auth path latency probe: tail p95=120ms -> 130ms, no errors. Good.

deploy-bot: progressing: 5% -> 15% (step 2)

jen: CDN warmup small invalidation for /assets/model/* queued after 35% pause.

maria: Proceed to 35%.

deploy-bot: progress: 15% -> 35% (step 3). Pausing per plan for manual validation.

ops-bot: Pause reached. Manual hold engaged. Notify channel when resuming.

raj: Running extended auth call sweep (10k synthetic calls). Observed ~0.6% 401s for a specific client pool (eu-corp-proxy). Investigating if proxy IPs are hitting rate limits on auth-service.

maria: Noted. Those 401s correlate with a spike in 429s from the same CIDR earlier. Could be a proxy misconfiguration. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.5% OR sustained 401/429 > 1% for 5m.

jen: Quick router debug: route rules show `x-client-type` header mapping to legacy path for that client pool. If they persist, we can ring-fence them to blue by adding header-based rule temporarily.

sre-oncall: I'm seeing a small p95 bump on green clients behind that proxy: green p95=480ms (up from 240ms). Not yet crossing abort, but concerning.

maria: Two options: (A) Proceed and risk broader tail impact, (B) apply a holdback rule for that CIDR to keep them on blue and resume shift. I prefer B to limit blast radius. Thoughts?

jen: I can push a header rule to router: `if src_cidr in 203.0.113.0/24 -> force cookie=blue` and route to blue pool. Low-risk change (config only).

raj: Confirmed additional auth rate limits for that pool. If we keep them on blue, green remains healthy for other customers. Recommend B.

maria: Go ahead Jen. Post the exact command here so we can rollback the rule after the window.

jen: Pushing temporary CIDR hold rule now.
```bash
# add temp hold rule
routerctl add-rule router-eu-west2 \
  --match "src_cidr=203.0.113.0/24" \
  --action "set_cookie=blue;set_weight=blue=100;set_weight=green=0" \
  --meta "temp-hold-1768511200"
```

ops-bot: Router rule added id=rule-1768511220 (temp-hold-1768511200). Change recorded.

deploy-bot: Manual hold released after rule application. Resuming traffic-shift.

maria: Resuming to 60% (skipping intermediate steps to shorten window since we mitigated the issue).

deploy-bot: progress: 35% -> 60% (manual override). Performing post-shift health checks.

sre-oncall: Snapshot: global p95=240ms, green p95=260ms, 5xx=0.03%, auth-401 for CIDR dropped to 0.0% (as expected). All within thresholds.

raj: Auth-service noted transient bursts earlier; engineering will follow up with that client to review proxy behavior.

maria: Good. Proceed to 100% when ready. Confirmed cache warming on green by infra.

deploy-bot: progress: 60% -> 100% (final). Rolling update of synapse-backend routing for green complete.

ops-bot: Snapshot of config stored: runbook note with rule id=rule-1768511220 and rollback snippet.

jen: Cleaning up temp rule now that traffic is on green.
```bash
# remove temp hold rule
routerctl remove-rule router-eu-west2 rule-1768511220
```

ops-bot: Rule rule-1768511220 removed. Change logged.

sre-oncall: Final watch: 30m post-shift. Current metrics: p95=230ms, 5xx=0.01%. No action needed.

maria: Tagging release: rel/2026-03-euw-b-slice. Updating release notes with incident note about temp hold: https://go/release/2026-03-euw-slice-b#notes

raj: Filing follow-up ticket ENG-Auth-342 to investigate client proxy behavior.

maria: Thanks team. Closing watch window and monitoring on-call handoff. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: traffic-shift job ts-1768511200 completed with status=done. Job artifacts saved to artifacts://shifts/1768511200

jen: DONE :shipit: 

maria: Closing thread. Cheers! :tada:
